1.w: The Lord abhors dishonest scales, but an accurate weight is his delight.

2.w: After pride came, disgrace followed; but wisdom came with humility.

3.w: The integrity of the upright guides them, but the crookedness of the treacherous destroys them.

4.w: Wealth does not profit in the day of wrath, but righteousness delivers from death.

5.w: The righteousness of the blameless will make their way smooth, but the wicked will fall through their own wickedness.

6.w: The righteousness of the upright will deliver them, but the treacherous will be ensnared by their own desires.

7.w: When a wicked person dies, his expectation perishes, and hope based on power has perished.

8.w: A righteous person was delivered out of trouble, then a wicked person took his place.

9.w: With his speech the godless person destroys his neighbor, but by knowledge the righteous will be delivered.

10.w: When the righteous do well, the city rejoices; when the wicked perish, there is joy.

11.w: A city is exalted by the blessing provided from the upright, but it is destroyed by the counsel of the wicked.

12.w: The one who denounces his neighbor lacks sense, but a discerning person keeps silent.

13.w: The one who goes about slandering others reveals secrets, but the one who is trustworthy conceals a matter.

14.w: When there is no guidance a nation falls, but there is success in the abundance of counselors.

15.w: The one who has put up security for a stranger will surely have trouble, but whoever avoids shaking hands is secure.

16.w: A generous woman gains honor, and ruthless men seize wealth.

17.w: A kind person benefits himself, but a cruel person brings himself trouble.

18.w: The wicked person earns deceitful wages, but the one who sows righteousness reaps a genuine reward.

19.w: True righteousness leads to life, but the one who pursues evil pursues it to his own death.

20.w: The Lord abhors those who are perverse in heart, but those who are blameless in their ways are his delight.

21.w: Be assured that the evil person will not be unpunished, but the descendants of the righteous have escaped harm.

22.w: Like a gold ring in a pig’s snout is a beautiful woman who rejects discretion.

23.w: The desire of the righteous is only good, but the expectation of the wicked is wrath.

24.w: One person is generous and yet grows more wealthy, but another withholds more than he should and comes to poverty.

25.w: A generous person will be enriched, and the one who provides water for others will himself be satisfied.

26.w: People will curse the one who withholds grain, but they will praise the one who sells it.

27.w: The one who diligently seeks good seeks favor, but the one who searches for evil—it will come to him.

28.w: The one who trusts in his riches will fall, but the righteous will flourish like a green leaf.

29.w: The one who troubles his family will inherit nothing, and the fool will be a servant to the wise person.

30.w: The fruit of the righteous is like a tree producing life, and the one who wins souls is wise.

31.w: If the righteous are recompensed on earth, how much more the wicked sinner!
